$comment: Known, tracked divergences between prisma/schema.prisma and the live database.
scripts/ci/check-db-drift.ts fails on any drift NOT listed here, so this file is
the reviewed record of what we are knowingly carrying and until when.
Every entry needs an owner, a reason, and an `expires` date. Past the expiry the
guard fails anyway — an allowlist without an expiry is just a permanently
disabled check, which is how the ledger reconciler ended up ignored.
Remove an entry the moment its fix lands. Do not add one to make CI green.
`destructiveStatementsAllowed` gates `npm run db:preflight`, which runs ahead of
every `db:push`. Entries are exact `prisma migrate diff --script` statements,
whitespace-insensitive. The reset is the only occasion that should add any.

destructiveStatementsAllowed.reason: #1300 widens the review unique to (consultantProfileId, consulteeProfileId, track) so a client who attends a webinar and later books the same consultant 1:1 holds one review of each product instead of one row that overwrites the other. Replacing a unique is a drop plus a create; the create cannot fail on this data (verified 2026-09-10: 0 duplicate pairs across 62 rows, and adding a column to a unique key can only split groups, never merge them). Remove this entry once the push has been applied and verified.
